text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“Nakayama Festa hangs on!
The door to the world is right before her eyes!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Keep going, Nakayama Festa!!
Just a little more!
That title is well within your grasp!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“Nakayama Festa finishes 2nd!
Is the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe truly this merciless?!”

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...—
Dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(Just one more step. If only I had the strength
to push forward one more step—)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Damn it.
What a weirdly realistic dream to show me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Staring at the computer in my room, narrowing down candidate accommodations for our away race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There are a few conditions. Are there training facilities nearby? And can we use them even for a short-term stay...?
choice_data_list: (The VR Uma-rator really made a difference)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've experienced the local atmosphere firsthand,
our plans should be far more concrete than when we knew nothing at all.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me.
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the joint training request with the famous local trainer
that was submitted through the academy... We've received a reply.
choice_data_list: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I received the documents from Ms. Tazuna and read the reply from the other party. The result was—
choice_data_list: ...Looks like it was no good.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Please don't be discouraged.
It seems rare for her to take on requests in the first place."
choice_data_list: That's true. I'll try asking someone else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Still, I wonder how many dozens of places had already turned me down by now."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To them, I'm just some rookie Trainer
who applied out of the blue.
Looking at my track record, it wouldn't be surprising if they turned me down."
choice_data_list: (Still, I can't afford to brood over this.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To be of whatever help I can to Nakayama Festa.
To ensure nothing is lacking as we head through this year.
—I will fulfill every role I possibly can."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...On the desk monitor,
footage of past Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe races was playing."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Here comes the hero from the outside! They're side by side!
Can she break away?! No, she's through!"
choice_data_list: (To accelerate so effortlessly on turf like that...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Now that we know, the gap between us and the world has become clear. Just how close can we get to closing it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The more I learned, the more vividly and distantly that goal appeared.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Sweets are the best when you're tired.
Here."
choice_data_list: ...Eh? Thank you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: It's chocolate. Though I just bought it at the same time as my own.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I am going—to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
And I'll show everyone my victory.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I know.
Yeah, I know.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: If you understand, that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...To get myself pumped up again,
I took out the chocolate I got from Nakayama Festa from the bag to eat it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The chocolate package had a tagline written on it:
"A tender night, a single piece of relaxation."
choice_data_list: ......I picked this up when I got mine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day. Before training started,
I called out to Nakayama Festa.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? A Valentine's gift in return?
choice_data_list: You gave me chocolate the other day, right?
You gave me chocolate the other day, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was pretty much just an excuse.
I hand her the present I had prepared.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: "...What's this? A heated eye mask?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, try using it before going to sleep.
Yeah, try using it before going to bed.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You're not going to tell me to take a break, huh.
choice_data_list: Even if I tell you, you wouldn't listen right now anyway, would you?
Even if I tell you, you wouldn't listen right now anyway, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose that's true.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, we're both in a spot where we have to push ourselves.
I'll gladly make good use of it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Nakayama Festa's complexion
looked just a little healthier than the day before.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? A return gift for Valentine's Day?
choice_data_list: Yeah, just tell me whatever you'd like to eat.
Yeah, just tell me whatever you'd like to eat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was more of an excuse than anything.
I had suggested it in the hopes of giving her even a brief moment to rest her mind, but—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Porridge, then.
choice_data_list: P-Porridge!? Not sushi or something!?
P-Porridge!? Not like, sushi or something!?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She might have been feeling exceptionally weak.
That evening, I quickly made some porridge and brought it to her, and—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...You really made it and brought it here.
choice_data_list: Of course, it's a thank-you gift after all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hah... you really are a softie
at heart, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks for the food.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: That had quite a gentle, mild flavor.
choice_data_list: Think about taking better care of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...To think there's someone
who's similar even in that respect.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'm going to sleep. We've got tomorrow to think about.
choice_data_list: I hope you have sweet dreams.
I hope you have sweet dreams.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. You too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Let's both do our best.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —I've forgotten what I dreamed about that night.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Still, if you slept soundly until morning, it must have been a very pleasant dream.
